name: Prumo Goal Authoring, Phasing & Lock Management
purpose: Author and manage Prumo Goals with measurable acceptance criteria, phased execution plans, evidence linkage, and lock discipline so scope stays explicit and locked criteria are never silently weakened.
inputs: Goal statement with the problem it solves and explicit non-goals
Acceptance criteria as measurable predicates with evidence types
Phase list with owners, exit gates, and inter-phase dependencies
Lock state: locked criteria, authorizer, commit, and timestamp
outputs: Activated Goal file with measurable criteria, phased plan, owners, and lock record
Living evidence ledger mapping each criterion to current evidence and status
Health report with stale flags, named blockers, and dated next actions
stop_conditions: All acceptance criteria satisfied with linked passing evidence and the Goal formally closed
Goal re-scoped with recorded authorization and updated phases, owners, and locks
Goal archived as obsolete with rationale and superseding reference
